headline: Trade Finance Expert Proposes 30-Day Emergency Plan for Malawi Fuel Shortage
summary: Business strategist Rhodrick Junaid Kalumpha proposed a presidential task force and a 30-day emergency plan to resolve persistent fuel distribution shortages in Malawi.
why: Malawi is a landlocked Southern African nation highly dependent on imported refined petroleum for domestic transport and trade.

impacts.name: Malawi
impacts.why: Fuel supply bottlenecks hinder domestic logistics and agricultural export distribution.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
